answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The basalt is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the shale. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
